description:
All aftermarket frames are available with the full range of Volcano Steering line.

Choose to refresh your setup to the max and save 25% from individual parts purchase.

The Sierra 18" inches Frameset includes: Sierra 18" inches Frame (Sergio Layos signature), Volcano 18" Forks, Volcano Stem 25S, and Volcano 15 Headset.

Sierra 18" Frame, Volcano 18" Forks, and Volcano Stems come with a Lifetime Warranty.
